description: Draft customer-support email dataset requiring human review. All emails, labels and summaries were generated by an LLM and are NOT independently human-verified ground truth.

cases.input: The app crashes as soon as I open it on my iPhone 14. It started right after the last update. Please fix this.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports that the app crashes immediately on launch on their iPhone 14 since the latest update.
cases.notes: Clear crash report tied to an update.

cases.input:
Hi, I was charged twice for my monthly subscription on the 3rd. There are two identical $29.00 charges on my card statement. Could you refund the extra one? Thanks,
Maria
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports being charged twice for their monthly subscription on the 3rd and asks for the duplicate charge to be refunded.
cases.notes: Duplicate charge and refund request; clearly a payment issue.

cases.input: What are your support hours? Are you open on weekends?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks what the support hours are and whether support is available on weekends.
cases.notes: Simple company information question.

cases.input: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer forgot their password and asks how to reset it.
cases.notes: Password reset is an account access matter.

cases.input: Hi, I've changed jobs and want to change the email on my account from my old work address to my personal one. Where do I do that?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer wants to change the email address on their account from their old work address to a personal one.
cases.notes: Profile/contact detail change.

cases.input: Hi, does your app have an offline mode? I travel a lot and wifi on trains is unreliable.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks whether the app has an offline mode because they travel often and train wifi is unreliable.
cases.notes: Feature inquiry; no malfunction is reported.

cases.input:
Hello,

Could you please send me a PDF invoice for March? My accountant needs it for our expense report.

Best regards,
Tom Fischer
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks for a PDF invoice for March for expense reporting.
cases.notes: Invoice request is a billing task.

cases.input: Getting a 500 error whenever I try to upload a CSV over 5MB. Smaller files go through fine.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer gets a 500 error when uploading CSV files larger than 5MB, while smaller files upload fine.
cases.notes: Specific error tied to file size.

cases.input: I cancelled my subscription in August and got a confirmation email, but there was a charge on my card in September and another one today. I'd like both refunded and I want to be certain nothing else gets taken.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says they cancelled in August but were still charged in September and again today, and asks for both charges to be refunded and for no further charges.
cases.notes: Charges after cancellation; primary need is a refund of recurring charges.

cases.input: It says my account is temporarily locked because of too many attempts. Fair enough, I did mistype my password a few times. How long do I have to wait before I can try again?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer's account is temporarily locked after repeated incorrect password attempts, and they ask how long they must wait before trying again.
cases.notes: Temporary lockout is an account access matter, not a software fault.

cases.input: Since Monday the dashboard takes forever to load, roughly 40 seconds. Two of my colleagues see the same thing, so it isn't just my laptop. As far as I know nothing has changed on our side.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports that the dashboard has taken about 40 seconds to load since Monday, for them and for colleagues.
cases.notes: Performance problem affecting several users.

cases.input:
Hello,

Our legal team is asking where your servers are located and whether customer data can be kept inside the EU. Do you have a document we can send them?

Regards,
Sofia
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks where the company's servers are located, whether data can be kept inside the EU, and whether there is a document for their legal team.
cases.notes: Company policy and compliance information request.

cases.input: I'm trying to decide between the Pro and Team plans. Our group has 6 people and we mostly share documents and comment on each other's work. What's the actual difference between the two?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks what the difference is between the Pro and Team plans for a six-person group that mostly shares documents and comments.
cases.notes: Pre-purchase product information. Plans are mentioned, but there is no payment problem, so this is not billing.

cases.input: Edits I make in the desktop app aren't showing up on my phone. I changed a document yesterday and the phone still displays the old version. Signing out and back in didn't help.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says edits made in the desktop app are not appearing on their phone, even after signing out and back in.
cases.notes: Sync failure. Signing out and in is only a troubleshooting step, not a login problem.

cases.input: I got a new phone and my authenticator app didn't come with it, so I can't get past the two-factor prompt. I know I saved backup codes somewhere but I can't find them. What are my options?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer cannot pass the two-factor prompt after getting a new phone without their authenticator app and cannot find their backup codes, and asks what their options are.
cases.notes: Account access blocked by two-factor authentication.

cases.input: I just noticed $240 left my account for an annual renewal. I never got a reminder, and honestly I'd forgotten I was on the yearly plan rather than monthly. I haven't used the service since spring. Is there any chance of getting this back?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer was charged $240 for an annual renewal without a reminder and asks whether it can be refunded since they have not used the service since spring.
cases.notes: Refund request for a renewal charge. Not using the service since spring is context for the refund, not a separate issue.

cases.input: I just got an email saying someone signed in to my account from Brazil. I'm in Germany and haven't been anywhere. Has someone gotten into my account? What should I do?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer received a sign-in alert from Brazil while they are in Germany and asks whether their account was compromised and what to do.
cases.notes: Possible account compromise; account security.

cases.input: My workspace has been read-only since Tuesday. I can't add new projects, and a banner says my payment failed. But my bank says there were no declined attempts from your side, and I've already updated my card twice. What's going on?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer's workspace has been read-only since Tuesday because of a payment-failed banner, although their bank shows no declined attempts and they have updated their card twice, and they ask what is happening.
cases.notes: The read-only symptom looks technical or account-related, but the cause the customer asks about is a failed payment. The primary need is resolving a payment problem, so billing.

cases.input: I've been using your product for five years and the new layout is awful. I can't find anything anymore and everything takes twice as many clicks. Was this change really necessary?
cases.ideal_summary: The long-time user says the new layout is awful, makes things harder to find and takes more clicks, and asks whether the change was necessary.
cases.notes: Complaint about design, not a malfunction. No bug or fix is requested, so general.

cases.input: Weird one. I can log in fine on the website, but the mobile app shows a white screen right after I enter my credentials. It's not the password, I used the same one on the site five minutes ago. Reinstalling didn't help either.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer can log in on the website, but the mobile app shows a white screen after they enter their credentials, even after reinstalling.
cases.notes: Login keywords, but the credentials work on the web, so the problem is an app malfunction. Technical.

cases.input: The Export to PDF button does nothing when I click it. Chrome, latest version.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports that the Export to PDF button does nothing when clicked in the latest version of Chrome.
cases.notes: Broken feature with a clear environment.

cases.input: I write a small newsletter about productivity tools and I'd love to explore a partnership with you. Who should I get in touch with?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer runs a small productivity-tools newsletter and asks who to contact about a partnership.
cases.notes: Partnership inquiry; not tied to billing, technical or account issues.

cases.input: why did my price go from $12 to $15 a month?? nobody told me about this
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks why their monthly price rose from $12 to $15 without notice.
cases.notes: Unexpected price change; billing question or dispute.

cases.input: Please delete my account and all the data attached to it. I don't use the service anymore.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks for their account and all associated data to be deleted because they no longer use the service.
cases.notes: Account closure request.

cases.input: Quick question: is a Linux desktop client on your roadmap? If so I'd move my whole team over right away.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks whether a Linux desktop client is planned and says they would move their team over if so.
cases.notes: Product roadmap inquiry.

cases.input: My account was suspended this morning with a vague message about violating the terms. I only ever post photos of my sourdough. I think this is a mistake, please can someone look at it?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer's account was suspended for an alleged terms violation, and they believe it is a mistake and ask for a review.
cases.notes: Account suspension and review request.

cases.input: Our webhook calls to your API started returning 429 errors this morning, even though we're sending the same volume as always, about 200 requests a minute. Your docs say the limit is 1000. Is there an incident going on?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer's API calls began returning 429 errors this morning despite steady volume of about 200 requests per minute, below the documented limit of 1000, and they ask whether there is an incident.
cases.notes: API error troubleshooting.

cases.input:
Hello,

Our invoices don't show our company's VAT number, and our finance team in Lyon won't reimburse them without it. Could you reissue the last three invoices with the VAT ID included? The number is already saved in our billing profile.

Thank you,
Camille Laurent
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks for the last three invoices to be reissued with their company VAT number because their finance team will not reimburse them without it.
cases.notes: Invoice correction request. The billing profile is mentioned only as where the number is stored.

cases.input: I upgraded to the Team plan yesterday because your pricing page said guests were unlimited. Now I find out there's a cap of 10 guests. Honestly I feel a bit misled. I'd like to go back to the Free plan and get this month's payment returned.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer upgraded to the Team plan believing guests were unlimited, discovered a 10-guest cap, and wants to return to the Free plan with this month's payment refunded.
cases.notes: Contains a product-information complaint, but the concrete ask is a downgrade plus refund, so billing.

cases.input: None of the task alert emails from your system have arrived since last week. I checked spam and the junk folder too. We rely on those to know when something is assigned to us. Other email is arriving normally.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says task alert emails from the product have not arrived since last week, including in spam, while other email arrives normally.
cases.notes: Email-related, but the issue is product notifications failing to send, not account verification or login emails. Technical.

cases.input: I'm thinking of cancelling at some point down the line. If I do, do you keep my projects, and for how long? I'd like to know before I commit to anything.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks whether their projects would be kept after a possible future cancellation, and for how long.
cases.notes: Mentions cancelling, but the customer is not cancelling or asking about charges. The question is about the data retention policy, so general.

cases.input:
Our team lead left the company last month and she was the only admin on our workspace. We now can't invite new people or change roles. We'd like admin rights transferred to me. We can prove we're the same company through our domain if needed.

Thanks,
Jakub
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says the workspace's only admin has left the company and asks for admin rights to be transferred to them, offering to prove company ownership through their domain.
cases.notes: Admin ownership transfer is an account access matter. It affects the team but is not billing or a product fault.

cases.input: The totals in my monthly report don't add up. The line items sum to 1,420 but the total at the bottom says 1,240. It looks like a calculation bug.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says their monthly report total of 1,240 does not match its line items, which add up to 1,420, and suspects a calculation bug.
cases.notes: Incorrect calculation in the product. Numbers are not charges, so not billing.

cases.input: I accidentally ended up with two accounts, one on my Gmail and one on my work email. Is it possible to merge them? The work one has all my projects.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer has two accounts under different email addresses and asks whether they can be merged, since the work account holds all their projects.
cases.notes: Account consolidation request.

cases.input: I had a promo code from your newsletter (SPRING20) but the discount didn't apply at checkout and I paid full price. Can you sort that out?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says the promo code SPRING20 did not apply at checkout, so they paid full price, and asks for this to be fixed.
cases.notes: Could be read as a checkout bug, but the request is to correct the amount charged, so billing.

cases.input: Where can I find the API documentation?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks where to find the API documentation.
cases.notes: Simple information request.

cases.input: We're doing an accessibility review of the tools we use. Is your web app usable with screen readers, and do you publish a VPAT or similar?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks whether the web app works with screen readers and whether the company publishes a VPAT or similar accessibility document.
cases.notes: Product and compliance information question.

cases.input: I'm in Canada and signed up at the CAD price of $18, but my card was billed $18 USD, which my bank converted to around $24 CAD. Could you look into this?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says they signed up at an $18 CAD price but were billed $18 USD, which their bank converted to about $24 CAD, and asks for it to be looked into.
cases.notes: Wrong-currency charge; billing dispute.

cases.input: Can I change my username? I picked something embarrassing in college.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks whether they can change their username because they find the one they chose in college embarrassing.
cases.notes: Profile change request.

cases.input: I can't install the desktop client on Windows 11. The installer stops with error code 1603.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer cannot install the Windows 11 desktop client because the installer stops with error code 1603.
cases.notes: Installation error with a specific code.

cases.input: Ever since our company moved to Okta I get 'user not provisioned' whenever I click Sign in with SSO. My coworkers can get in without trouble.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer gets a 'user not provisioned' error when signing in via SSO since their company moved to Okta, while coworkers can sign in.
cases.notes: An error message appears, but the issue is whether this user's identity is provisioned for access. That is an account-access matter rather than a product bug.

cases.input:
Hi,

I opened a project I've been working on for months and about half of the images have been replaced by grey placeholder boxes. It was totally fine last night. I haven't deleted anything, I swear, and I haven't touched the asset folder. I'm honestly panicking because the client presentation is tomorrow at nine and this is the whole deck. Please tell me this is fixable. I can send screenshots if that helps.

Thank you so much,
Nadia
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says about half the images in a months-long project now appear as grey placeholders although they deleted nothing, and needs this fixed before a client presentation tomorrow at nine.
cases.notes: Emotional and urgent, but the need is troubleshooting missing content. No cause is stated, so the summary should not claim data loss or a specific bug.

cases.input: Love the product! Quick question: is there a mobile app or is it web only? Also, whoever sped up the loading last week, thank you.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer praises the product and asks whether a mobile app exists or whether it is web only.
cases.notes: The thanks about loading speed is not an issue. The question about mobile availability is the only request.

cases.input:
Hi,

Our company has changed its name, so from now on could invoices show our new legal name, Northwind Logistics Ltd? Nothing else about the account needs to change, only what appears on the invoices.

Thanks,
Priya
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks for future invoices to show their company's new legal name, Northwind Logistics Ltd, after a company name change.
cases.notes: A name change might look like an account profile edit, but the customer limits it explicitly to the name shown on invoices, so billing.

cases.input: This is my third email about this. I cancelled my plan inside your 14-day refund window and I was still charged. If I haven't heard back by Friday I'm going to dispute the charge with my bank.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says this is their third email about being charged after cancelling within the 14-day refund window and will dispute the charge with their bank if they do not hear back by Friday.
cases.notes: Refund dispute with an escalation threat. The tone is angry but the need is a refund.

cases.input: Do you offer discounts for schools or nonprofits? I teach a small after-school coding club and we have almost no budget.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks whether discounts exist for schools or nonprofits for a small, low-budget after-school coding club.
cases.notes: Eligibility and policy question with no existing subscription. Compare with an existing customer asking to change their price, which is billing.

cases.input: Dark mode flashes white every time I switch tabs in Firefox on Linux. Minor, but it's annoying.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports that dark mode flashes white whenever they switch tabs in Firefox on Linux.
cases.notes: Minor visual bug with a clear environment.

cases.input: I signed up about an hour ago but the verification email never came. Checked spam too. Without that I can't activate the account.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer signed up an hour ago but has not received the verification email, including in spam, and cannot activate their account.
cases.notes: Account activation blocked. Contrast with product notification emails failing, which is technical.

cases.input: Search isn't finding documents I know exist. I searched the exact title of a file I created last month and got zero results, but I can open it from the folder.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says search returns no results for a document they created last month, even when searching its exact title, although they can open it from the folder.
cases.notes: Search feature not working as expected.

cases.input: I've tried to pay for the Pro plan three times now and it keeps saying the transaction could not be processed. My card works everywhere else, I just used it at the grocery store. Is something wrong on your end?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer's payment for the Pro plan fails repeatedly with a transaction-could-not-be-processed message although their card works elsewhere, and they ask whether something is wrong on the company's side.
cases.notes: A failing checkout could be a technical fault, but the customer frames it as a payment being declined, so billing.

cases.input: Heads up, I reused my password on another site that just got breached. How do I change it here, and can I sign out of all my other devices at the same time?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reused a password on a site that was breached and asks how to change it and sign out of all other devices.
cases.notes: Account security.

cases.input: Hi, our procurement team asked for a copy of your SOC 2 report. Is that something you share, and if so how do we request it?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks whether the company shares its SOC 2 report and how to request it for their procurement team.
cases.notes: Compliance information request.

cases.input: How do I create a shared folder? I looked through the menus and couldn't find the option.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks how to create a shared folder because they could not find the option in the menus.
cases.notes: How-to question. No malfunction is reported, so general rather than technical.

cases.input: I keep receiving emails from you addressed to someone called Daniel Reyes. I'm not Daniel and I've never signed up for your service. Someone must have used my address by mistake. Can you take my email off his account please?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer keeps receiving emails addressed to another person and asks for their email address to be removed from that person's account.
cases.notes: Unwanted emails look like a notifications issue, but the fix is correcting the email address on someone else's account, so account.

cases.input: We removed two people from our workspace last week but this month's bill still lists 8 seats. We should only be paying for 6. Can you adjust it?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says their bill still lists 8 seats after two members were removed and asks for it to be adjusted to 6.
cases.notes: Seat count on an invoice; billing even though members were removed in the product.

cases.input: Every so often, maybe once a day, the app freezes for about a minute and then recovers by itself. I can't make it happen on demand. It might be related to having lots of tabs open, or the VPN, but I really am not sure. Nothing in the error log that I can see.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports the app freezing for about a minute roughly once a day and then recovering, with no reliable way to reproduce it.
cases.notes: Vague and intermittent, but clearly a performance or stability problem with no cue words for another category.

cases.input: My surname is spelled wrong on my profile. It should be Özkan, not Oskan. How can I fix it?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks how to correct the misspelling of their surname on their profile.
cases.notes: Profile detail correction.

cases.input: Push notifications show up twice on my Android phone, every time. Same on my tablet. I haven't changed any settings.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports that push notifications appear twice on both their Android phone and tablet, though they changed no settings.
cases.notes: Duplicate notification bug across devices.

cases.input: You approved my refund 10 days ago but I still don't see it on my card. How long does it usually take to show up?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks how long an approved refund, issued 10 days ago, normally takes to appear on their card.
cases.notes: Refund timing question.

cases.input:
Hello,

We're a 40-person design agency and we're currently evaluating a few tools to replace what we use now. Before we start a trial, I need to know whether you integrate with Slack, Asana and HubSpot, and whether there's a way to bulk import projects from CSV. Our operations lead also asked whether integrations are included in every plan or only the higher tiers. If there's a product overview or a feature matrix you could point us to, that would be perfect.

Many thanks,
Holly Brandt, Studio Operations
cases.ideal_summary: A prospective customer from a 40-person agency asks whether the product integrates with Slack, Asana and HubSpot, supports bulk CSV import, and includes integrations on all plans.
cases.notes: Long and multi-part, but every part is a pre-sales product question. The plan question concerns feature availability, not billing.

cases.input: The export feature has crashed on me every single time since the last update, and I've lost most of a week to it. I'm done. Please cancel my plan and refund the last two months, since I effectively couldn't use it.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says the export feature has crashed every time since the last update and asks to cancel their plan and refund the last two months.
cases.notes: Describes a crash, but that is the reason for the request, not the request itself. The actual ask is cancellation and a refund, so billing.

cases.input: What's the best way to reach an actual person? The chatbot keeps going in circles.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks how to reach a human agent because the chatbot keeps going in circles.
cases.notes: Contact-channel question; no specific billing, technical or account issue is stated.

cases.input: I closed my account last year and I'd like to come back using the same email. When I try to sign up it says the email is already in use, but I can't log in either. Not sure what to do.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer closed their account last year and wants to return with the same email, but sign-up says the email is in use and they cannot log in.
cases.notes: Account reactivation and access.

cases.input: When I go to your login page Chrome shows a 'Your connection is not private' warning. I haven't clicked through it. Is the site safe? It started this afternoon.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer sees a connection-not-private warning in Chrome on the login page since this afternoon and asks whether the site is safe.
cases.notes: Mentions the login page, but the issue is a connection or certificate error rather than account access. Technical.

cases.input: I'm following your guide for connecting Google Calendar. After I authorise, I land on a page that says redirect_uri_mismatch. I've checked the redirect URI I entered three times and it matches what's in the guide character for character. Any idea what else could cause this?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer gets a redirect_uri_mismatch error after authorising the Google Calendar connection despite checking the redirect URI against the guide, and asks what else could cause it.
cases.notes: Integration troubleshooting with a specific error. It is a technical problem rather than a how-to question.

cases.input: A former colleague still has access to our shared team account and I want him removed right away. He now works for one of our competitors and I don't want him seeing client files. I'm the person who set the account up.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer wants a former colleague, now at a competitor, immediately removed from their shared team account, and says they set up the account.
cases.notes: Access removal for security reasons, so account. The mention of client files is the motivation, not a data issue.

cases.input: Hello, I'm a journalist writing a piece on remote-work tools. Would someone on your team be available for a few questions this week?
cases.ideal_summary: A journalist writing about remote-work tools asks whether someone on the team can answer a few questions this week.
cases.notes: Media inquiry; not tied to any support issue.

cases.input: There's a charge on my statement from a name I don't recognise: PAYSVC*APPTEAM 9.99. Is that you guys? I want to check before I report it as fraud.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer sees an unrecognised 9.99 charge labelled PAYSVC*APPTEAM and asks whether it is from the company before reporting it as fraud.
cases.notes: Unrecognised charge, so billing. 'Fraud' is a keyword here, not an account-security issue.

cases.input: It'd be great if recurring tasks could repeat on custom schedules, like every three weeks. Right now I only see daily, weekly and monthly. Is that something you'd consider adding?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks whether custom repeat intervals such as every three weeks could be added, since only daily, weekly and monthly options exist.
cases.notes: Feature request rather than a bug report. Nothing is reported as broken, so general.

cases.input:
Hello,

I've been a paying user for about two years. I started a master's program this autumn and saw you offer a student discount. Is it possible to apply it to my existing subscription from the next payment onwards?

Kind regards,
Emre
cases.ideal_summary: The customer, now a student, asks whether the student discount can be applied to their existing subscription from the next payment.
cases.notes: Mentions a discount but concerns changing the price of an existing subscription, so billing. A general question about discount eligibility would be general.

cases.input: The audio is out of sync with the video in recordings made with the screen recorder. About half a second behind.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports audio in screen recordings lagging about half a second behind the video.
cases.notes: Clear feature malfunction.

cases.input: How do I turn on two-factor authentication for my account?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks how to turn on two-factor authentication for their account.
cases.notes: Account security setting.

cases.input: The Sign in with Google button used to work, but now it tells me no account was found for my email. I haven't changed anything. I really need to get into my projects.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says Sign in with Google now reports that no account exists for their email, though nothing changed, and they need to access their projects.
cases.notes: Login method failing; account access.

cases.input: Is the app available in Spanish?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks whether the app is available in Spanish.
cases.notes: Simple product information question.

cases.input: My scheduled weekly report ran twice this morning and went out to my whole team both times. Now everybody thinks I spammed them. Has this happened to others?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says their scheduled weekly report ran twice this morning and was sent to the whole team both times, and asks whether others have seen this.
cases.notes: Duplicate scheduled job; technical malfunction.

cases.input: How do I switch from monthly to yearly billing? I saw there's a discount for paying annually.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks how to switch from monthly to yearly billing to get the annual discount.
cases.notes: Subscription billing change.

cases.input:
We're a registered nonprofit and our tax-exempt certificate has been on file with you since January, yet this month's invoice includes sales tax. Please correct it and refund the tax we were charged.

Regards,
Dana Whitfield, Operations
cases.ideal_summary: The customer, a registered nonprofit with a tax-exempt certificate on file, says this month's invoice includes sales tax and asks for it to be corrected and refunded.
cases.notes: Invoice tax error; billing.

cases.input: I imported a spreadsheet with 3,000 contacts yesterday but only 2,100 of them show up in the list. There was no error message, and the import screen said success. I need to know what happened to the other 900.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says only 2,100 of 3,000 imported contacts appear despite a success message, and asks what happened to the other 900.
cases.notes: Import problem with no error shown. Technical, even though the customer asks an open question.

cases.input: locked out. urgent. demo at 3pm
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says they are locked out of their account and urgently needs access before a demo at 3pm.
cases.notes: Extremely short. Locked out points to account access; no other issue is described.

cases.input: What is your refund policy? I'm thinking of signing up for the annual plan but want to understand the terms first.
cases.ideal_summary: The prospective customer asks about the refund policy before deciding whether to sign up for the annual plan.
cases.notes: Contains the word refund, but no charge or dispute exists. It is a policy question about terms, so general.

cases.input: The app keeps crashing and I also need to change the email on my account because I lost access to the old inbox. For now, please just help me change my account email; I'll report the crashes separately.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer prioritizes changing their account email after losing access to the old inbox and will report app crashes separately.
cases.notes: Edge case: ambiguous (account/technical). Both issues are real, but the explicit current request is changing the account email; crashes are deferred, so account is dominant.

cases.input: My invoice looks wrong, but finance is handling that in another ticket. I need you to fix the dashboard: clicking any project gives a blank page even though I can sign in.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer requests a fix for project pages appearing blank after sign-in, while a separate ticket handles an invoice issue.
cases.notes: Edge case: ambiguous (billing/technical). The invoice issue belongs to another ticket; the dominant request here is fixing blank project pages, so technical.

cases.input: Refund duplicate charge.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer requests a refund for a duplicate charge.
cases.notes: Edge case: extremely short (three words). The refund request is explicit; do not invent an amount or payment date.

cases.input: Support hours?
cases.ideal_summary: The customer asks about support opening hours.
cases.notes: Edge case: extremely short (two words). This is a general information request without evidence of an account, payment, or product fault.

cases.input: Reset my password please.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer requests a password reset.
cases.notes: Edge case: extremely short (four words). Password reset identifies account access; do not infer compromise or a specific login error.

cases.input: The uplod buton dosnt do anythng when I clik it. Pls fix it, I cant uplod my files.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer reports that the upload button does nothing and asks for it to be fixed so they can upload files.
cases.notes: Edge case: typos. Multiple misspellings obscure upload, button, and click, but the requested action is repairing a broken upload feature.

cases.input: I canceld my subscripshun but got charegd agen today. Pleese refnd todays paymnt.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer says they were charged again today after cancelling their subscription and requests a refund of today's payment.
cases.notes: Edge case: typos. Misspelled cancellation, charge, refund, and payment terms still express a refund request; do not infer when cancellation occurred.

cases.input: Merhaba, does your app support offline editing? Seyahatte internetim olmuyor, sadece bu özellik var mı öğrenmek istiyorum.
cases.ideal_summary: Müşteri seyahatte internet erişimi olmadığı için uygulamanın çevrimdışı düzenlemeyi destekleyip desteklemediğini soruyor.
cases.notes: Edge case: mixed-language (Turkish/English). This asks about feature availability, not a malfunction; the draft summary uses Turkish, the predominant framing language.

cases.input: Hola, perdí mi teléfono y no tengo los backup codes. Please help me recover access to my account; no puedo pasar la verificación en dos pasos.
cases.ideal_summary: El cliente perdió su teléfono, no tiene los códigos de respaldo y pide recuperar el acceso a su cuenta porque no puede superar la verificación en dos pasos.
cases.notes: Edge case: mixed-language (Spanish/English). Recovery from a two-factor access block is account support; the draft summary uses the predominant language, Spanish, without asserting a product bug.

cases.input: Bonjour, depuis la mise à jour le bouton Export affiche 'Something went wrong'. Could you fix it? Tous mes exports échouent.
cases.ideal_summary: Le client signale que tous ses exports échouent depuis la mise à jour avec un message d’erreur et demande une correction.
cases.notes: Edge case: mixed-language (French/English). The English request and French fault description concern failed exports; the draft summary uses the predominant language, French.

cases.input: Fantastic, you charged me twice for the same month. I always wanted to pay double for exactly the same thing. Please refund the extra charge.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer complains about being charged twice for the same month and requests a refund of the extra charge.
cases.notes: Edge case: sarcastic. Fantastic and wanting to pay double express dissatisfaction, not praise or consent; the actual request is refunding the duplicate charge.

cases.input: Brilliant redesign: finding the help page now deserves an Olympic medal. Nothing is broken; I just want a direct link to the user guide, please.
cases.ideal_summary: The customer criticizes how difficult the help page is to find and requests a direct link to the user guide.
cases.notes: Edge case: sarcastic. Brilliant and the Olympic medal remark criticize navigation rather than praise it; the explicit request is documentation, with no malfunction reported, so general.
